description:
Activate Slimefoot by paying {4}, creating a 1/1 Saproling and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Saproling and Squirrel, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
The Saproling dies, triggering Slimefoot, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.
